summary.intent: Run the Validate (Nyquist) gate for Phase 77 (crypto hygiene and terminology canonicalization) to audit validation coverage and update VALIDATION.md, while a background SDK E2E gate re-verified the phase's IPNS/key-lifecycle and TEE wire-field renames.
summary.outcome: VALIDATION.md was updated to compliant based on the passing crypto suite (210 tests) and committed; the E2E gate's 2 tee-republish failures were traced to a stale, pre-rename tee-worker container and a misconfigured API, so the worker was rebuilt from current source and the API restarted correctly wired to it, with the TEE round-trip suite re-run to confirm the renamed wire field didn't break the API/worker contract.

repo: If the API isn't started with TEE_WORKER_URL pointing at :3002 (with matching TEE_WORKER_SECRET), initializeFromTee() silently falls back to mock-ipns-routing on :3001 and leaves tee_key_state empty, causing tee-republish tests to fail at the precondition rather than on real logic.

A long-running tee-worker container being 'healthy' doesn't mean it's current — after a phase renames a wire field on both API and worker (e.g. encryptedIpnsKey -> encryptedIpnsPrivateKey), the worker container must be rebuilt from current source or the round-trip test won't actually exercise the new contract.
THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET can be left empty in .env for local E2E runs since throttling is typically off in dev.
workflow: gsd-validate-phase's State A path (VALIDATION.md already exists) audits the existing draft against SUMMARY.md/VERIFICATION.md and updates statuses to green rather than regenerating from scratch.
Running the Validate (Nyquist) gate inline while the SDK E2E gate executes in the background lets both proceed without blocking each other.

friction: SDK E2E gate initially failed (104/106) due to local TEE infra being misconfigured/stale, not due to actual regressions — required manual diagnosis (container uptime check, secret check) before the real validation could proceed.
Had to rebuild the tee-worker container mid-session because it was running pre-rename source, adding a wait step before the TEE suites could be trusted.
open_items: TEE republish suite re-run against the rebuilt worker and correctly-wired API was still in progress at the end of the transcript — final pass/fail result not yet confirmed.
CodeRabbit CLI review (step 6) was queued to run on the committed VALIDATION.md changes but not yet executed.
